scientific_integrity: The general theorem is proved by finite Boolean duality from atom partitions, integer sorted-fiber inequalities, balancing transfers, multinomial enumeration, and strict partial-average inequalities. Exhaustive subset-semantics checks for small sizes and a 9-to-3 example independently corroborate finite instances only. Self-review passed; external independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: One global monotone threshold on a nonempty finite powerset algebra. Morphisms preserve all Boolean operations and the threshold, not merely truth at marked worlds. Claims do not extend to locally varying neighborhood frames, arbitrary weights, or normal additivity. Old integer-weighted voting-game literature could implicitly contain arithmetic criteria, so the categorical/counting formulation still requires external priority evaluation.
title: Sharp arithmetic morphism criterion and fiber-rigidity transition for finite quorum modal algebras
